manifest.name: dsh-plugin-novel-reader
manifest.description: 摸鱼小说阅读器 for DeepSeek Harness：状态栏悬停速览 + 侧边栏阅读，支持 txt / epub，毛玻璃背景可调。兼容 dsh-better-sidebar 与 dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine。

scripts.check: node tools/build.mjs && node --check lib/client.js && node --test test/*.test.mjs

bundle.text:
# 只插入本插件一行，不替换任何官方组件。
- insert:
    - id: novel-reader
      name: dsh-plugin-novel-reader

readme.text:
<div align="center">

[**简体中文**](https://github.com/overflow7782/dsh-plugin-novel-reader/blob/master/README.md) · [English](https://github.com/overflow7782/dsh-plugin-novel-reader/blob/master/README.en.md)

DeepSeek Harness 插件 · 在状态栏里偷偷看小说 [](https://github.com/overflow7782/dsh-plugin-novel-reader/actions/workflows/check.yml) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-novel-reader) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-novel-reader) [](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Harness) [](package.json) [](LICENSE) ---

| 功能 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| **状态栏速览** | 输入框下面那排（`dock`）多一个书本图标，鼠标移上去弹出毛玻璃速览窗，移开就收起，点一下可以钉住 |
| **位置随手挪** | 按住图标左右拖动，它插到状态栏的另一格，旁边的控件平滑让位；设置里还有一条轴可以指定位置。 |
| **大小随手改** | 速览窗四边四角都能拖，拖动时显示实时像素尺寸；底边上下拖就是改与图标之间的间距 |
| **侧边栏阅读** | 右侧栏「小说」页签是完整阅读器，带书架和目录，`←` `→` 翻章 |
| **老板键** | 默认 `Shift+F1`，一下收起速览窗并关掉侧边栏的「小说」页签；右键速览窗只是收起速览窗。 |
| **收起顶栏** | 默认 `Shift+F2`，或点速览窗右上角那个小箭头，顶部那一排按钮收起、正文占满整个窗口；鼠标移到窗口顶部的小横条就能叫回来。设置里也有开关 |
| **格式** | `txt`（UTF-8 / GBK / GB18030 / UTF-16，按「第 x 章」等分章，识别不到就按字数切）· `epub`（目录优先 nav，其次 NCX） |
| **外观** | 字号、行距、段距、字体、首行缩进、文字颜色；书架和目录浮层可单独设色；毛玻璃与 `dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine` 同刻度同配方，也可以一键同步 |
| **伪装输入框模式**（beta） | 速览窗改用输入框那张卡片的底色与模糊，边框和投影全去掉，看起来就是输入框延伸出来的一块 |

需要 **DSH 0.2.1+** 和 **Node.js 22+**。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-plugin-novel-reader
```

网页宿主把 `desktop` 换成 `web`。装完重启 DSH，或按 `Ctrl+Shift+R` 强制刷新。

也可以从 [Releases](https://github.com/overflow7782/dsh-plugin-novel-reader/releases) 下载 `dsh-plugin-novel-reader.tgz` 直接安装。

卸载：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-plugin-novel-reader
```

1. 打开右侧栏，点「小说」，把 `txt` / `epub` 点进来或直接拖进书架
2. 鼠标移到状态栏的书本图标上，浮出速览窗；点图标可以钉住
3. 设置 → **小说阅读**，调字号、颜色、玻璃、速览窗大小位置和快捷键

| 插件 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `dsh-better-sidebar` | 装了之后会用它的 `registerTab` 注册「小说」页签，没装会走 DSH 原生右侧栏。 |
| `dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine` | 检测到它时可以「一键同步毛玻璃」，之后跟着它实时变化 |

状态栏图标挂在官方的 `conversation.composer.dock` 插槽上，和自带的活动、用量胶囊同一排。往这一排插东西的其他插件也能一起换位。

计划中的功能，欢迎提意见。

| 功能 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| **在线书源导入** | 导入书源规则（订阅地址或 JSON），配自己的源，也能导出分享给别人 |
| **在线书源搜索** | 按书名或作者跨源搜，点一下进书架，章节按需拉取并缓存 |
| **整本离线缓存** | 整本预下载到 IndexedDB，网卡、断网也能翻 |
| **书签与笔记** | 位置书签、划线、几句随感，能导出成 Markdown |
| **书内全文搜索** | 在一本书里搜关键词，点结果直接跳到那一段 |
| **朗读** | 用浏览器 TTS 读当前段落，配合自动滚动跟着走 |
| **epub 插图** | 把 epub 里内嵌的图片渲染出来 |
| **阅读统计** | 今天读了多少字、连了几天，摆进设置页 |
书的正文、书架和阅读进度存在本机页面的 IndexedDB（库名 `dsh-novel-reader`），外观设置存在 localStorage。插件不访问网络。卸载插件后数据还在，要在书架里逐本删。

欢迎 fork 和 PR，动手前先读 [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/overflow7782/dsh-plugin-novel-reader/blob/master/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md)。两条硬要求：`npm run check` 必须全绿；改了 `src/` 要把 `lib/client.js` 一起提交——CI 会重新构建并比对产物，产物没同步会直接失败。

[简体中文](https://github.com/overflow7782/dsh-plugin-novel-reader/blob/master/README.md) · [**English**](https://github.com/overflow7782/dsh-plugin-novel-reader/blob/master/README.en.md)

A DeepSeek Harness plugin · read novels in the status bar [](https://github.com/overflow7782/dsh-plugin-novel-reader/actions/workflows/check.yml) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-novel-reader) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-novel-reader) [](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Harness) [](package.json) [](LICENSE) ---

| Feature | Details |
|---|---|
| **Peek from the status bar** | The row under the composer (`dock`) gets a book icon. Hover it for a frosted peek window, move away to dismiss, click to pin |
| **Move it anywhere** | Hold the icon and drag left or right — it drops into another slot of that row and the controls beside it slide over smoothly. Settings also has an axis to pick the slot |
| **Resize it** | All four edges and four corners of the peek window resize it, with a live pixel readout; dragging the bottom edge changes the gap above the icon |
| **Reader in the sidebar** | The "Novels" tab in the right sidebar is a full reader with a shelf and table of contents, `←` `→` to change chapters |
| **Boss key** | `Shift+F1` by default — dismisses the peek window and closes the "Novels" sidebar tab; right-clicking the peek window only dismisses it |
| **Collapse the top bar** | `Shift+F2` by default, or the small arrow at the top-right of the peek window: the button row folds away and the text fills the whole window; hover the little bar at the top edge to bring it back. There is a switch in the settings too |
| **Formats** | `txt` (UTF-8 / GBK / GB18030 / UTF-16, split on chapter head

Requires **DSH 0.2.1+** and **Node.js 22+**.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-plugin-novel-reader
```

Use `web` instead of `desktop` for the web host. Restart DSH afterwards, or press `Ctrl+Shift+R`.

You can also grab `dsh-plugin-novel-reader.tgz` from [Releases](https://github.com/overflow7782/dsh-plugin-novel-reader/releases) and install it directly.

Uninstall:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-plugin-novel-reader
```

1. Open the right sidebar, click "Novels", then pick or drag in `txt` / `epub` files
2. Hover the book icon in the status bar for the peek window; click it to pin
3. Settings → **Novel Reader** to tune fonts, colors, glass, and the peek window's size, position and shortcut

| Plugin | Details |
|---|---|
| `dsh-better-sidebar` | When installed it registers the "Novels" tab through its `registerTab`; otherwise the plugin uses DSH's native right sidebar |
| `dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine` | When detected you can sync its glass in one click, and it keeps following along live |

The status bar icon lives in the official `conversation.composer.dock` slot, next to the built-in activity and usage pills. Other plugins that add controls to that row can be reordered with it.

| Feature | Details |
|---|---|
| **Online book sources** | Import source rules (subscription URL or JSON), keep your own set, export them to share |
| **Search across sources** | Search by title or author, add a hit to the shelf, pull chapters on demand and cache them |
| **Offline cache** | Pre-download whole books into IndexedDB so they read fine on a bad or dead connection |
| **Bookmarks and notes** | Position bookmarks, highlights, short notes, exportable as Markdown |
| **In-book search** | Full-text search inside a book, jump straight to a hit |
| **Text to speech** | Read the current paragraph aloud, following along with the auto-scroll |
| **epub images** | Render the illustrations embedded in an epub |
| **Reading stats** | Words read today, streak, shown in settings |

Book text, the shelf and reading progress live in the page's IndexedDB (database `dsh-novel-reader`); appearance settings live in localStorage. The plugin makes no network requests. Data survives uninstalling — remove books from the shelf to clear it.

Forks and pull requests are welcome. Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/overflow7782/dsh-plugin-novel-reader/blob/master/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md) first. Two hard rules: `npm run check` must pass, and any `src/` change must ship with the rebuilt `lib/client.js` — CI rebuilds and diffs the bundle, so a stale one fails the build.
[MIT](LICENSE)
